isc_access_requests._note: Simplified model of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) roles, access profiles and access request approvals. Reviewer types, self-approval prevention, autoApprove, the missing-reviewer sequence, reminders, escalations, the fallback approver and the 90-day timeout follow SailPoint's documentation (checked 2026-11-06); the comparison rules, the escalation of governance groups and the 'block' SoD action are simplifications.

concepts.entitlement: A single permission on one source, such as membership of one group or one transaction code, aggregated into Identity Security Cloud.
concepts.access profile: A bundle of entitlements from one source that can be requested or granted as a unit.
concepts.role: A business-level bundle of access profiles and entitlements that matches a job and can be assigned automatically by membership criteria or requested.
concepts.membership criteria: Rules on identity attributes, joined with AND and OR, that decide which identities a role is automatically assigned to.
concepts.governance group: A named group of identities that can act as one reviewer, where any single member's decision completes the step.
concepts.work reassignment: A setting an identity makes so that new approvals assigned to them during a time window go to another identity instead.
concepts.fallback approver: The identity that receives a request when the escalation chain is exhausted or a reviewer cannot be found.
concepts.separation of duties policy: A rule naming two sets of access that one identity must not hold together, checked when access is requested.

outcome_definitions.ASSIGNED: The identity matches the role's membership criteria (or is on its identity list), so the role and its access are granted without a request.
outcome_definitions.NOT_ASSIGNED: The identity does not match the role's membership, or the role is disabled or its criteria cannot be evaluated.
outcome_definitions.APPROVED: Every reviewer level approved, so the access is provisioned.
outcome_definitions.PENDING: A reviewer level is still waiting for a decision from the current approver.
outcome_definitions.DENIED: A reviewer denied the request, the request timed out, or an input was unknown or not allowed (deny by default).
outcome_definitions.NOT_REQUESTABLE: The item exists but is disabled or not marked requestable, so it cannot be requested in the Request Center.
outcome_definitions.ALREADY_HAS_ACCESS: The recipient already holds the item, directly or through a role, so no request is created.
outcome_definitions.SOD_VIOLATION: Granting the item would give the recipient both sides of a separation of duties policy.
